title: VLG-Net: Video-Language Graph Matching Network for Video Grounding

problems.name: Cross-Modal Semantic Alignment Gap
problems.evidence_sentence: Previous studies [16, 18, 55] employ a cross-modal processing unit designed to jointly model text and visual features through simple operations such as element-wise addition, Hadamard product, and direct concatenation of a moment’s representation and the query embedding.

problems.name: Long-Video Evidence Sparsity and Efficient Selection
problems.evidence_sentence: Motivated by the work in [72], we propose to leverage the representational capability of graphs to encode snippetsnippet, token-snippet, and token-token relations as graph edge connections.

problems.name: Multi-Moment, Compositional, and Complex Query Grounding
problems.evidence_sentence: We demonstrate superior performance over state-of-the-art grounding methods on three widely used datasets for temporal localization of moments in videos with language queries: ActivityNet-Captions, TACoS, and DiDeMo. # Abstract Grounding language queries in videos aims at identifying the time interval (or moment) semantically relevant to a language query.

methods.name: Contrastive or Cross-Modal Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Previous studies [16, 18, 55] employ a cross-modal processing unit designed to jointly model text and visual features through simple operations such as element-wise addition, Hadamard product, and direct concatenation of a moment’s representation and the query embedding.

methods.name: Memory, Graph, or Structure Alignment
methods.evidence_sentence: Fueled by recent advances in Graph Neural Networks, we propose to leverage Graph Convolutional Networks to model video and textual information as well as their semantic alignment.

methods.name: Transformer/DETR-Style Proposal Decoding
methods.evidence_sentence: VLG-Net: Video-Language Graph Matching Network for Video Grounding Grounding language queries in videos aims at identifying the time interval (or moment) semantically relevant to a language query.

methods.name: Multi-Modal Fusion and Feature Enhancement
methods.evidence_sentence: A Graph Matching layer is adopted for cross-modal context modeling and multi-modal fusion.
